page_title: CRY 0-0 WHU | Crystal Palace v West Ham 20/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+5' The corner kick from Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
90+5' A cross from Tomas Soucek (West Ham) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. West Ham force a corner. They send men into the box.

90+3' Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) reacts well and displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross from the free kick. He jumps high and produces a header which goes well over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for West Ham.
90+2' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) receives a yellow card for infringement.
90+2' A yellow card for a tackle by El Hadji Malick Diouf (West Ham). Darren England doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
90+1' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.

89' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Jaydee Canvot (Crystal Palace) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for West Ham.
87' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
85' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
84' Substitution. Taty Castellanos walks off the pitch and Mohamadou Kante (West Ham) comes on as a substitute.
84' El Hadji Malick Diouf (West Ham) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Crystal Palace.
83' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
81' Crystal Palace can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
80' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
80' Taty Castellanos (West Ham) bends a great shot in from the edge of the box, but Dean Henderson makes a smart save to deny him.
79' Justin Devenny (Crystal Palace) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort. The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.
78' Here's the change. Brennan Johnson leaves the pitch and Justin Devenny (Crystal Palace) comes on as a substitute.

78' A snap shot by Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom right corner, but Mads Hermansen produces a good save to thwart him. The linesman makes the right call and Crystal Palace will have a corner.
76' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) sends a cross into the box, but Mads Hermansen comes off his line to gather the ball.
75' Nuno Espirito Santo has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Callum Wilson (West Ham) replacing Pablo.
74' A lofted cross from Kyle Walker-Peters (West Ham) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
73' Mateus Fernandes (West Ham) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
71' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
68' The corner from Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) is intercepted by Dean Henderson.

67' El Hadji Malick Diouf (West Ham) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. West Ham will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
66' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
65' Taty Castellanos (West Ham) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
64' El Hadji Malick Diouf (West Ham) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
63' Kyle Walker-Peters (West Ham) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
62' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Mads Hermansen, who smothers the ball.
61' Mateus Fernandes (West Ham) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
59' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Will Hughes as he is replaced by Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace).
59' Here is a change. Jorgen Strand Larsen is going off and Oliver Glasner gives the last tactical orders to Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace).
59' It will be a substitution. Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) is ready to enter the pitch as Yeremy Pino walks off.
58' Yeremy Pino (Crystal Palace) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
58' The resulting corner from Yeremy Pino (Crystal Palace) is cleared by the opposition's defence.

57' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. Crystal Palace have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
57' Pablo (West Ham) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.
56' Yeremy Pino (Crystal Palace) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
55' Brennan Johnson (Crystal Palace) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Mads Hermansen intercepts the ball.
54' The resulting set piece from Crystal Palace is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
53' Brennan Johnson (Crystal Palace) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. Crystal Palace force their opponents to concede a corner.
51' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
51' The resulting corner from Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.

50' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety. The ball goes out of play and West Ham have been awarded a corner kick.
46' Axel Disasi (West Ham) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Darren England blows for a foul.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' Darren England blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+3' Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.

45+1' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) finds some space on the edge of the box after some nice individual play and curls a shot in on goal, but the ball flies just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

44' What a save from Dean Henderson! Konstantinos Mavropanos (West Ham) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
44' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
42' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Crystal Palace) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.

40' Brennan Johnson (Crystal Palace) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch. El Hadji Malick Diouf (West Ham) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
39' Taty Castellanos (West Ham) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
38' Mateus Fernandes (West Ham) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
36' The free kick is taken by Mateus Fernandes (West Ham), but ball is cleared.
35' Darren England blows his whistle after Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. West Ham have a free kick.
34' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
33' Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Darren England has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
31' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
30' Kyle Walker-Peters (West Ham) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. West Ham have been awarded a corner kick.
28' Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) dribbles into space and finds himself in a shooting position, but his shot from the edge of the box is bravely blocked.

27' Good team movement sets up Brennan Johnson (Crystal Palace) on the edge of the box, but he slices the ball narrowly wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for West Ham.
26' A cross into the box from Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) is cleared.
24' The resulting free kick from Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) ends up in the gloves of the keeper.
23' A clumsy foul by Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) and Darren England blows his whistle. It's a free kick to West Ham in a dangerous position.
21' Brennan Johnson (Crystal Palace) sees a yellow card from Darren England after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.

20' What a wasted chance that is! An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Brennan Johnson (Crystal Palace) who sends his header well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.
18' Good clearance! Brennan Johnson (Crystal Palace) received a low pass, but he didn't have time to do anything as one of the defenders quickly stole the ball off him.
16' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.

15' Taty Castellanos (West Ham) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Crystal Palace.
14' Darren England blows his whistle for a foul after Brennan Johnson (Crystal Palace) hacks down one of his opponents.
12' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
10' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Kyle Walker-Peters (West Ham), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
8' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace).
7' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Crystal Palace) fires a shot well wide of the left post from inside the box after latching onto a short pass. The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.
6' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle.
5' Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
4' Yeremy Pino (Crystal Palace) commits a rough foul. Darren England stops the game and makes a call.
3' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) sprays a pass out to Taty Castellanos, but he can't beat his man to get to the ball.
2' Kyle Walker-Peters (West Ham) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
West Ham will kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Darren England.
